items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I’m going to play with Ralph tonight.

ctx.x: And I hope to hear your soprano sax again tonight.

Oh, yeah, I’m going to play tonight, yeah. I’m going to play with Ralph tonight. The first set tonight is with Ralph, so I love to play the soprano with Ralph. I’m going to surprise him and play “Poor Butterfly” tonight. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -14-

I’m just fascinated by watching the interaction that goes on stage, especially when you’re doing, in the middle of a tune, and someone’s soloing, and one of the horn players will start a background riff. Like last night, I can’t even remember what set it was, but someone set up a two bar riff and the second time the riff came around everybody had it.
